_about: What the Discovered panel lists: things on the bus whose kinds (a protocol that saw them, the scanner's kind segment or their device_class) contain one of these words, case-insensitive: the control surfaces this designer lays out. Tunables only: source holds no device list. An empty list shows everything.
_measured: Bench broker 2026-11-04 (ROAD-3502). 'midi' confirmed: protocol midi, kinds Input / Output, device_class 'MIDI Interface' (e.g. midi/Device/Input/Dev1/model 'Arturia MicroLab:Arturia MicroLab  28:0'). 'hid' is PLUGIN.SPACENAVIGATOR's BareMetal target (config.ini target = HID, read as an agent kind), but the plugin is 'unavailable' on the bench (no device plugged), so nothing matches it today. 'surface' was dropped: no plugin publishes a protocol, kind or device_class with that word.
